title: Pakistan vs India vs Bangladesh: income per person, 1990 to 2025

content.hook: In 1990 they were almost equal. Who's richest today?
content.title: GDP per person, 1990 → 2025
content.subtitle: current US$ · not inflation-adjusted
content.source_note: Source: World Bank (CC BY 4.0) · PAK series has a statistical break in 2000

beats.text: In 1990, all three were under 400 dollars per person.
Through the two thousands, Pakistan and India stayed neck and neck.
Then Bangladesh, the poorest of the three in 1990, overtook both by 2019.
In 2025, India is at about 2,700 dollars, Bangladesh 2,600, and Pakistan 1,600.

content.takeaway: Same starting line. Very different paths.
content.cta: Which number surprised you? Follow for more data stories.
